E-01.start: Application running against the seeded database; no session cookie.
E-01.steps: Open the application root; the router sends an unauthenticated visitor to /login.
E-01.expected: Login form with email, password and one Log in action; protected routes are unreachable.
E-01.actual: Empty form shown, with no credentials prefilled and no error alert.

E-02.start: Seeded customer account exists; signed out.
E-02.steps: Enter customer1@campusbites.test with a wrong password and submit.
E-02.expected: 401 with the generic message "Invalid email or password."; no session is created and the form stays.
E-02.actual: Generic alert shown; no redirect and no detail that would reveal whether the account exists.

E-03.start: Signed in; the seeded catalogue contains available, low-stock and sold-out items.
E-03.expected: THB prices; sold-out items cannot be added; the low-stock hint is visible; the cart starts empty.
E-03.actual: Prices in THB; Chicken Sandwich and Pad Thai show Sold out with disabled Add; Mango Sticky Rice shows "1 left"; the cart is empty.

E-04.steps: Open the menu at 430 px width.
E-04.expected: The same catalogue information, sold-out states and prices stay visible and usable at phone width.
E-04.actual: Sold-out badges, the low-stock hint, disabled Add buttons and the anonymous "Log in to order" action all remain visible without clipped controls.

E-05.start: Signed in; menu loaded; both chosen items are in stock.
E-05.steps: Add Basil Pork Rice (THB 60.00) twice and Thai Iced Tea (THB 30.00) once.
E-05.expected: Two cart lines with line totals, an estimated total of THB 150.00, an empty pickup note and an enabled Place order action.
E-05.actual: Two lines, correct line totals, estimated total ฿150.00 and an empty pickup note.

E-06.start: The cart already contains Mango Sticky Rice; the item becomes sold out before submission (the test prepares this state).
E-06.expected: 409 ITEM_UNAVAILABLE with an inline alert; both cart lines and the total stay on screen; no navigation.
E-06.actual: The alert "Mango Sticky Rice is sold out." appears; both lines and the total remain and the URL does not change.

E-07.steps: Place the order; the SPA follows the 201 response to the order detail.
E-07.expected: Order number, PENDING and UNPAID badges, the server total, line items, pickup note and a first history entry by CUSTOMER.
E-07.actual: CB-000003 shows Pending and Unpaid, both lines with unit prices, ฿150.00 and the first history entry "Order placed" by CUSTOMER.

E-08.start: Three orders exist for Alice: CB-000001 accepted, CB-000002 and CB-000003 pending.
E-08.expected: Only the caller's orders, newest first, with number, placed time, status and total.
E-08.actual: CB-000003, CB-000002 and CB-000001 are listed newest first with their statuses and totals; no other customer's orders appear.

E-09.start: Two PENDING orders exist, CB-000001 and CB-000002, placed one second apart.
E-09.steps: Log in as operator and open Incoming orders; the Pending filter is the default.
E-09.expected: Pending orders oldest first, with distinct placed times and an Accept action on each row.
E-09.actual: CB-000001 appears above CB-000002 at 9:21:05 PM and 9:21:06 PM; both are PENDING and both have Accept.

E-10.start: The same dashboard; CB-000001 is still PENDING.
E-10.steps: Inspect the CB-000001 row immediately before the acceptance click.
E-10.expected: The row shows PENDING and a green Accept button, so the status and the action are visible together.
E-10.actual: Row CB-000001 is PENDING with its Accept button visible; no status change has happened yet.

E-11.start: The Accept action on CB-000001 has just completed.
E-11.steps: Switch the filter to All and wait for the refreshed list.
E-11.expected: CB-000001 is ACCEPTED with no action button; CB-000002 is still PENDING with Accept; the All filter is active.
E-11.actual: All is selected; CB-000001 is Accepted with no action; CB-000002 remains Pending with Accept.

E-12.start: CB-000001 has been accepted by the operator.
E-12.steps: Open the order detail as Alice.
E-12.expected: ACCEPTED status and a two-entry history: placed by CUSTOMER, then Pending to Accepted by OPERATOR, each with a timestamp.
E-12.actual: Accepted badge with the history rows "Order placed" and "Pending to Accepted" and their timestamps.

E-13.start: Signed in as a customer with no operator role.
E-13.expected: An in-place 403 Forbidden alert; no operator table and no order data.
E-13.actual: "403 Forbidden: You have no access to this page." is shown instead of the table; the API also returns 403 without order data (TEST-37, TEST-38, TEST-43).

E-14.start: Signed in with an active session.
E-14.expected: The session is cleared and the empty login form is shown; the old cookie is rejected on the next request.
E-14.actual: The login form is shown again; TEST-06 asserts that the old session receives 401 on the next request.
